subject: Request: AWS marketplace volume-based credit for FastRetail pilot
messages:
From: Paul Sanders <paul.sanders@fastretail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fastretail.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for volume-based marketplace credit for FastRetail pilot

Hi Marcus / Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move the pilot into production. Procurement asked me to follow up with a formal ask so they can align with finance and legal. High level:

- We plan to run a 12-month pilot starting Jan 1 that we expect to ramp to ~$1.2M ARR on Redwood usage in year one (estimate attached).
- To make this viable via the AWS Marketplace listing (our procurement policy prefers marketplace transactions), they're asking for a volume-based credit applied to marketplace usage for the first 12 months. Specifically, they're requesting a 15% credit applied to reported marketplace spend during year one.

We'd prefer to keep this on the marketplace listing rather than a private offer, if possible, to speed procurement and to keep transparency for our finance team. Can Redwood approve a credit or convertible marketplace concession? If not, what is the fastest path to a private-offer-style concession?

Attached: FastRetail_usage_forecast.xlsx (forecast and expected consumption profile)

We need an answer by end of week to keep our January kickoff. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Paul Sanders
VP of Product
FastRetail

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Deal Desk <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:34:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request for volume-based marketplace credit for FastRetail pilot

Folks — forwarding FastRetail's request. Key context: large strategic retail prospect, strong co-sell interest from AWS (we're in touch with their partner team), and procurement insists on Marketplace flow.

Ask: can Deal Desk approve a marketplace-applied, volume-based credit of 15% for year one? If not, propose alternative structure (private offer credits, usage tiers, or one-time onboarding credit). Need clear decision and list of required approvals (legal, marketplace publishing, finance) by EOW so we can keep Jan kickoff.

Attachments forwarded: FastRetail_usage_forecast.xlsx, proposed_terms_draft.docx

Thanks — Marcus
Head of Sales, Retail Segment
Redwood Inference

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 13:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for volume-based marketplace credit for FastRetail pilot

Marcus — thanks for the context and the forecast. A few follow-ups before we escalate to legal/finance:

1) Confirmed ARR: the forecast shows $1.2M ARR — is that ACV for the first 12 months or total expected vendor spend including infra?
2) List price / SOW: what is the baseline marketplace list price we'd use so we can model margin impact and channel split?
3) AWS co-sell involvement: do we have an AWS co-sell contact committed to joint outreach? If AWS is co-selling, marketplace credits need to respect channel rules (marketplace SKUs vs private offer).
4) Suggested concession: per Deal Desk playbook, we have authority to approve up to 10% marketplace credits for strategic pilots. Anything above 10% requires Finance + Legal + Marketplace Publishing approval and must be structured as a private offer to avoid broad public discounting.

If the customer will accept a private-offer flow, we can get it done faster and cap the exposure. If they insist on a marketplace-applied credit, we need finance to sign off on a 15% exception.

Please send the ACV breakout and proposed list price + expected first-year consumption by EOD so I can model impact. I've attached the current pricing_workbook_v2.xlsx template — fill the highlighted tabs.

-Rishi
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for volume-based marketplace credit for FastRetail pilot

Adding proposed structure from sales ops / field finance:

- Recommendation: Offer a structured private-offer that mirrors a 12% effective credit in year one (applied as a concession line item in the private offer). This protects public list integrity, keeps the deal in Marketplace flows for procurement (they can accept private offers via marketplace), and caps our exposure.
- Rationale: 12% is a middle ground between their ask (15%) and Deal Desk authority (10%). We can condition it on: a minimum 12-month term, a 90-day ramp milestone (usage thresholds with clawback if ramp misses), and AWS co-sell confirmation.
- Approvals required: Legal (term language + clawback), Finance (P&L impact sign-off), and Marketplace Publishing (private-offer SKU setup).

If Leadership (Laura) is comfortable with the 12% private-offer concession, Ops can prepare the pricing workbook and the private-offer draft this week. I'll tag Marketplace Publishing immediately after approval.

Attachments: pricing_workbook_v2.xlsx (filled sample)

-Vanessa
Sr. Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

---

From: Paul Sanders <paul.sanders@fastretail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fastretail.com, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for volume-based marketplace credit for FastRetail pilot

Thanks Marcus / Vanessa — the private-offer option and 12% effective credit are workable for us as long as the private-offer can be accepted via the AWS Marketplace (procurement needs the marketplace flow for purchase orders). Procurement attached a signed MOU draft (attached) and asked that we move quickly so their legal can finalize.

We can accept the ramp milestones and the 12-month commitment. Please proceed with private-offer creation; let us know if you need any additional info from our finance team.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Paul

Attachments: Signed-MOU-scan.pdf

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for volume-based marketplace credit for FastRetail pilot

Perfect — proceeding with the 12% private-offer structure and the ramp milestones. Action items:

- Vanessa: prepare private-offer draft and pricing workbook, publish to Marketplace private-offer SKU pending approvals. (Owner: vanessa_ortiz)
- Rishi: coordinate Finance + Legal sign-off on clawback language and confirm P&L impact; route approvals. (Owner: rishi_malhotra)
- Laura: final leadership ok to proceed with the 12% exception requested here.

I'll open the HubSpot deal (HUBSPOT-47092) and flag the AWS partner team. Marcus

Redwood Inference
